title: Pay the major bank levy
what: A levy is imposed each quarter on an ADI whose total liabilities exceed the levy threshold.

sources.title: Major Bank Levy Act 2017
sources.quote: 4 Imposition of levy (1) Levy is imposed on an ADI for a quarter starting on or after 1 July 2017 if the total liabilities amount for the quarter in relation to the ADI exceeds the levy threshold for the quarter.

reach.condition: if its total liabilities exceed the levy threshold

confidence_note: Marks follow the register's assessment of the Major Bank Levy (cth-major-bank-levy-2017); the price mark is placed with the largest players, the only banks that pay it.

assessment.summary: A levy is imposed each quarter on an ADI whose total liabilities exceed the levy threshold.

marks.reason: A tax on some banks' liabilities distorts funding costs and can be passed on to all borrowers.
Narrows the major banks' funding cost advantage over smaller rivals.
